description: AmiVoice API is the cloud speech-recognition API of Advanced Media, Inc., founded in 1997 and headquartered in Tokyo (Toshima), Japan, listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange Growth market. It offers end-to-end and hybrid engines for Japanese, including medical, finance and insurance domain engines, plus English, Chinese, Korean and a mixed Japanese/English/Chinese engine. Processing and storage run in AWS data centers in Japan; prices are in JPY.
name: AmiVoice
